text:
maya: heads-up — deploybot auto-pinned runtime v3.4 for llama3q in canary after a small spike in OOMs at 03:04 UTC :eyes:

deploybot: auto-pin triggered by 3 consecutive OOM alerts on canary-llama3q (shard-7). Pin applied: runtime=3.3 -> 3.4 blocked. Reason: kernel mismatch on quant path.

maya: ok thanks. Is there a rollback window or are we planning an unpin once a shim lands?

adele: quick summary from telemetry: requests with seq_len>4096 saw ~1.2% failure rate post-3.4, memory pressure primarily on 80k-context jobs. Short seq traffic unaffected.

tj: can we hotpatch kernel or prefer rolling back runtime? Hotpatch ETA?

adele: kernel hotpatch is non-trivial, infra estimates 2-3 hours (might need node reboot). Rolling back runtime is ~15m with deploybot if approved.

maya: given customer-facing impact (small but steady errors), leaning rollback to 3.3 on canary and pause unpin until we validate shim. Thoughts?

sanjay: +1 rollback on canary. Then run extended longseq smoke (12h) against canary traffic. If clean, we can attempt a phased unpin next change window.

adele: agree. Will run targeted longseq eval once rollback completes.

maya: ok @deploybot please queue rollback to runtime=3.3 for canary cohort (region: us-west-2) and set TTL 6h to auto-re-evaluate. Include an annotation for kernel-drift investigation.

deploybot: acknowledged. Command queued:
```
/deploy rollback runtime=3.4 -> runtime=3.3 --target canary-us-west-2 --ttl 6h --annot "kernel-drift-llama3q-80k-context"
```

deploybot: rolling back in 5m, watch channels: #eng-releases and #eng-runtime. Will post status.

tj: once rollback is live, run small perf diff for latency and mem before we mark rollback complete. Adele to confirm.

adele: running warmup + perf diff post-rollback. I'll post results in this thread. Planning: warmup script and then:
```
# quick smoke
curl -sS -X POST https://canary.api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"model":"llama3q","seq_len":8192,"prompt":"warmup"}'
```

maya: FYI product/CS heads notified about temporary regression and mitigation. We'll draft a short blurb for release notes and incident log once we have final outcome.

deploybot: rollback started: 1767832350. Current status: 2/3 canary shards rolled back.

adele: perf diff after 2 shards: memory error rate dropped to 0.05%, p95 latency unchanged. Continuing.

deploybot: rollback completed at 1767832620. All canary shards reverted to runtime=3.3. TTL timer set to expire at 1767836020 (6h).

maya: thanks. Adele please post full telemetry dump and recommended next steps (shim patch vs staggered unpin).

adele: will post telemetry + repro steps. Early signal suggests kernel path in 3.4 interacts poorly with 8-bit quantized longseq batches. Recommend:
- run regression tests with quantized longseq on staging nodes with 3.4 kernel
- if hotpatch ETA <4h and low risk, consider hotpatch then unpining; otherwise schedule staggered unpin next change window (02:00 UTC) with canary->regional rollforward plan.

tj: also adding a follow-up to release notes: "3.4 temporarily rolled back in canary for llama3q due to memory regressions on long-context quantized workloads; mitigation in progress."

maya: good. I'll add rollout/rollback notes and link to this thread in the postmortem draft. Closing ops for now — keep thread updated with telemetry and any further deploybot actions. :thumbsup:
